rules.adapter-copy-semantics: F3 owns move/copy behavior. Distinct-adapter rows require the copy semantics inherited from their underlying value, not merely a spelling alias.
rules.compile-time-evaluation: F7 explicitly owns comptime. Comptime functions, reflection/layout queries and const evaluation remain there, even when their runtime result is an ordinary scalar.
rules.constant-time-verification: The campaign does not assign constant-time taint verification and the no-secret-branch code-generation contract to F2. Keep these outside until their milestone is named, rather than ignoring the attribute.
rules.core-aggregates-and-rows: F1 structs/functions and F2 enum/match/error-row constructs; the source uses no later-milestone language surface.
rules.core-collections-and-text: F2 lists/strings/ranges/byte-scalar conversion. Unknown descriptors remain implementation blockers until checked; they are not a reason to count a program as already executed.
rules.core-control-and-output: Ordinary function/loop/error control and existing standard-output/error-stream output do not introduce memory modes, user generics, closures, modules or host APIs beyond the compiler execution boundary.
rules.core-diagnostics-and-origin: Diagnostic allow attributes and subscript-origin attributes change the behavior of existing F2 scalar/collection constructs, not a later language surface.
rules.core-numeric: F2 core expressions include ordinary scalar numeric values/conversions/operators and wrapping arithmetic; no memory modes, generics/traits, closures, modules, foreign or host surface is required.
rules.distinct-adapter-conversion: Judgment required: this closed-cast-set row uses a distinct scalar adapter without exercising the copy contract. The campaign does not explicitly place adapter conversions. Do not count it either way until ruled.
rules.first-class-function-values: Judgment required: the campaign places closures at F4 but does not explicitly place capture-free top-level function values and indirect calls. Do not count these rows inside or outside F2 until ruled.
rules.generic-std-combinator: F4 owns traits/generics and standard-library compilation. sorted invokes the generic standard-library combinator and ordering trait.
rules.host-surface: F7 owns the OS surface. Networking and clock/sleep builtins are OS calls even though their names do not begin fs_, os_ or env_.
rules.json-runtime-builtins: Judgment required: JSON parser/query/value builtins are not explicitly allocated by the campaign. They are neither plain string operations nor OS calls. Do not count them either way until ruled.
rules.nested-function-values: F4 owns closures; this source defines and passes a nested function value, with the same function-lifting mechanism.
rules.process-channel-surface: F7 full parity owns the remaining process/task/channel/monitor/select runtime surface; these are not F2 enums, collections, errors, strings or traps.
rules.regex-generalized-literal: Judgment required: the regex generalized literal and regex matcher are not explicitly allocated by the campaign. String syntax alone does not establish their F2 membership.
rules.unsafe-and-foreign: C imports, unsafe expressions and foreign ABI declarations are not assigned to F2 by the campaign. Preserve them outside the campaign language until their milestone is ruled; do not gain credit by treating them as scalar casts.
